title: An improved method to generate secondary nanoplastics and oligomers: application in ecotoxicology
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN00866A, Paper
Silvia Gómez-Kong, Miguel Tamayo-Belda, Gerardo Pulido-Reyes, Carlos Edo, Irene Verdú, Francisco Leganés, Roberto Rosal, Miguel González-Pleiter, Francisca Fernández-Piñas
An efficient method was developed to produce secondary nanoplastics and oligomers, mimicking environmental conditions. The produced materials caused physiological changes in the microalga C. reinhardtii at environmentally relevant concentrations.
